articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Deere Leans On AI And Digital Platforms For New Growth Engine. Deere is rolling out AI-powered autonomous tractors and expanding its digital agriculture platforms as it pushes further into precision farming. The company is also moving deeper into construction technology with the acquisition of Tenna, a connected equipment and asset management platform. Together, these moves mark a clear shift for Deere toward technology-driven solutions across farming and construction. Earlier this week, Deere & Company reported fiscal first-quarter results showing a steep drop in profit and revenue versus last year, even as it maintained its US$1.62 per-share dividend and continued to face tariff-related margin pressures.
